en.headline: Government issues yellow travel alert for France amid ongoing protests
en.dek: The Security Bureau raised a yellow alert for France on Tuesday, citing continued demonstrations that have led to violent clashes and damage, and advised Hong Kong residents to avoid crowds and protest areas.
body: The Hong Kong SAR Government issued a yellow outbound travel alert for France on Tuesday in response to the latest situation involving ongoing protests across multiple locations that have caused violent conflicts and destruction.

A government spokesman said the yellow level indicates signs of threat. Hong Kong residents planning to travel to or already in France should stay alert, pay attention to local announcements, avoid crowded places and refrain from going to demonstration areas unless necessary.

The Security Bureau will continue to monitor developments closely and release updates through the media, its mobile app and the outbound travel alert webpage. Hong Kong residents abroad who need assistance can contact the Immigration Department’s Assistance to Hong Kong Residents Unit on the 24-hour hotline 1868 or through other channels including the mobile app, WhatsApp and the online form.

zh.headline: 港府對法國發出黃色外遊警示 呼籲港人避開示威區域
zh.dek: 鉴於法國多地持續示威造成暴力衝突及破壞，特區政府周二對法國發出黃色外遊警示，呼籲港人提高警覺並避開人群聚集地方。
body: 香港特區政府周二對法國發出黃色外遊警示，因應當地最新示威活動情況，多個地方持續發生暴力衝突及破壞。
政府發言人表示，黃色外遊警示級別表示有威脅蹟象。計劃前往或已在法國的港人應留意局勢，提高警覺，注意當地公布，避開人群聚集的地方，非必要應避免前往示威區域。
保安局會繼續密切留意法國局勢，並透過媒體、流動應用程式及外遊警示網頁發布最新消息。在外港人如需協助，可致電入境處「協助在外香港居民小組」24小時求助熱線1868，或使用流動應用程式、WhatsApp等渠道。
